'''Miguel Font Puig'''{{family name footnote|lang=Catalan|Font|Puig}} (born 6 August 1963) is an Andorran [[Alpine skiing|alpine skier]]. He competed in [[Alpine skiing at the 1980 Winter Olympics|three events]] at the [[1980 Winter Olympics]].<ref name="SportsRef">{{cite Sports-Reference |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/fo/miguel-font-1.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200418080135/https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/fo/miguel-font-1.html |url-status=dead |archive-date=18 April 2020 |title=Miguel Font |accessdate=19 March 2018 |quote=Full name: Miguel Font Puig}}</ref> He is the brother of alpine skier [[Carlos Font]].<ref name="SportsRef" />
